decisions.reason: Suggestion mode and comments facilitate editorial review but do not alter the existing approval gate; relying on author judgment to recommend changes does not authorize implementation without review.
The source concerns manuscript revision workflow and does not change companion-resource content, format, or delivery expectations.
The source does not change the AI chapter's inclusion, topic, format, coverage, or length guidance.
The source does not address or change the pre-interview preparation chapter.
The source provides editing and commenting instructions but does not change required or conditional answer layers.
The source does not change the first-time leader chapter's topic, format, or question-count policy.
The source does not address global-market coverage or how the global perspective is integrated.
The source does not change the remote and hybrid leadership chapter's content, format, or question-count rule.
Providing a reference PDF and specifying the working manuscript does not change the guide's purpose, format, audience, or principal markets.
The source does not address or change the chapter about questions candidates can ask interviewers.
Expected deletion and introduction of questions does not itself revise the established 50,000-word maximum, 13,000-word allocation, or chapter allocation rules.

The statement that questions may be deleted or introduced reiterates the existing modernization activity and author recommendation role without changing the current modernization objective, coverage, or authorized actions.
